name: joplin-plugin-recall
description: Rediscover your notes: random review, on this day, and whole-library writing statistics that count CJK correctly.

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
scripts.test: tsc --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2018 --lib es2018 --skipLibCheck tools/wordcount.test.ts && node .test-build/tools/wordcount.test.js

author: smiletalker
